translation_notes: prefixes: SSTIM->sstim, SSTIM_V->sstimv (with `as SSTIM_V` since the body still indexes it with SSTIM_V[name] -- a Namespace subscript, which has no island form), SSTIM_EX->sstimex, RDF->rdf, SKOS->skos.

Every graph.objects/subjects one-step read becomes m{ }; every next(graph.objects(...), None) becomes m{ }.first(); the sorted(graph.subjects(...)) traversal keeps its Python sorted() around a m{ } iterable.

module_paths()/instance_paths() (manifest + directory walk, not RDF) are outside the region's context; shim.py supplies them, pointed at fixture_module.ttl/fixture_instance.ttl for both sides. main() takes no argument, so the driver calls it with no fixture= graph -- the two ttl files ARE the fixture.
